name: orc_extraction_r134a
title: ORC with two-stage expander and intermediate extraction (R134a)
summary: R134a Organic Rankine Cycle (T_ev = 90 °C, T_cd = 30 °C) whose screw/scroll-type expander is described stage by stage: isentropic first expansion, extraction of a fraction of the flow at an intermediate pressure, isentropic second expansion and constant-volume discharge; the extracted vapour is mixed with the exhaust and cools the pumped liquid in an internal heat exchanger. For a specified 5 kW expander power it determines the displaced volume (21.2 cm3), the extracted fraction (13.2 %), the pressures, all state points, a 35.6 kW boiler duty and a cycle efficiency of 11.7 %.

authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory) — probable, to be confirmed by the maintainer

verification.notes: compare_solution.py prints '132 common variables, 72 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 31'. The largest printed difference over all common variables is 1.00e+00 (res and the three quality sentinels x_f_su_pp, x_f_ex_pp, x_f_int_exp: EES stores -100/100 for quality() outside the dome and a res of 1.1e-4 W, CoolSolve 0 and -1.1e-11); max_rel_diff 0.00262 is the maximum printed after excluding those four variables and the 52 h/u/s variables, which differ by a constant reference-state offset (+148.19 kJ/kg on h and u, +795.80 J/(kg K) on s: EES default R134a reference vs CoolProp IIR) and agree within 7.5e-4 (h, u) and 6.7e-4 (s) after removing it. The 16 physical variables between 1.1e-3 and 2.6e-3 (largest M_dot_f_ext 2.62e-3; Q_dot_hex 2.0e-3, W_dot_pp 1.8e-3, x_ext 1.7e-3, V_s_exp 1.15e-3) are the R134a equation-of-state differences (specific volume +0.21 %) propagated through the sizing; the other 60 agree within 1e-3. All 133 equations of the original are unchanged (W_dot_exp = 5000, epsilon_s_pp = 0.5 and the three Q_dot_hex statements determine V_s_exp, x_ext and the recuperator outlet); a worker's earlier rearranged specification (V_s_exp, x_ext, w_pp imposed from the stored solution) was reverted after review C-38. The shipped .initials is required (from default guesses the block of 21 stops on a singular Jacobian); 21 iterations with it.
